verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Scheduled Rollouts, which let a Feature Gate be deployed gradually over time on a schedule. That is the product's own scheduling capability for releases. The evidence does not show setting an arbitrary flag change, such as an on/off toggle or a rule edit, to fire at a specific future date and time. Missing for 10: explicit one-off flag changes at a chosen future timestamp, details on configuring schedule start times and steps, scheduling of non-rollout changes (experiments, configs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.
Schedule gradual feature rollouts to safely deploy new code
